entries.087ced83e827c3f8: This business covers banking and consumer loans. The banking business is run by ORIX Bank Corporation (100% of its voting rights held by the company), and in addition to investment real estate loans, which are the core of its revenue, it is expanding its Merchant Banking Business. In the consumer loan business, it aims to expand financial services for individuals through joint business arrangements with companies that have strong customer and business bases. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥76,439 million, up 21% from the previous year, making it the smallest of the 10 reportable segments. By breakdown, finance income was ¥78,903 million (up 31%). The number of employees is 934 (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.33631e2fd6294c41: A business that conducts corporate investment and concessions. In corporate investment, it aims to enhance the corporate value of investees and to achieve continuous capital gains through portfolio rotation. It views business reorganizations, such as business succession arising from a lack of successors, carve-outs and going private, as investment opportunities, and plans to expand its investment methods as well. In concessions, it states that it will strengthen the operating structure of the 3 Kansai airports (Kansai International Airport, Osaka International Airport and Kobe Airport) and actively pursue the operation of public infrastructure other than airports. Kansai Airports Co., Ltd., which the company established with French airport operator VINCI Airports S.A.S. in December 2015 and which operates Kansai International Airport and Osaka International Airport, is an affiliate in which the company's ownership ratio of voting rights is 40%. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥441,953 million, up 17% from the previous year. By breakdown, sales of merchandise and real estate were ¥301,345 million (up 19%), service income was ¥87,063 million (up 26%), and operating lease income was ¥36,441 million, down 15%. Number of employees was 7,794 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.4674cd04725bc018: This is a business in which ORIX Corporation USA, based in Dallas, United States (the company's ownership ratio of voting rights is 100%), conducts finance, investment, asset management and advisory services. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥272,219 million, up 77% from ¥154,228 million in the previous year. As a factor behind the increase in consolidated operating revenue, the recording of fund valuation gains at subsidiaries in the United States is cited. Number of employees was 2,070 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.72316f077e7b0dca: This is a business in which ORIX Corporation Europe N.V., based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands (the company's ownership ratio of voting rights is 100%), conducts global equity and bond asset management. It was preceded by Robeco Groep N.V., an asset management company acquired in July 2013; in October 2016, it acquired additional shares and became a wholly owned subsidiary. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥291,086 million, up 13% from the previous year. Number of employees was 1,645 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.8a717d254df0ea45: A business in which ORIX Life Insurance Corporation sells life insurance. It sells through agencies, financial institutions such as banks, face-to-face sales with in-house consulting proposals, and direct marketing, and its basic product development policy is to offer products that respond promptly to diverse and changing customer needs. In asset management, it is working to expand investment in highly profitable assets, including alternative assets, and to rebalance its portfolio flexibly. [[term:segment|Segment]] revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥643,045 million, up 24% from the previous year, and was the largest of the 10 reportable segments. The main components of the increase were life insurance premium income and investment income (¥642,904 million). Number of employees was 2,095 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.904a2055b86eb2ef: This business engages in investment and management of aircraft, and investment, financing, management and brokerage related to ships. It is carried out by companies such as ORIX Aviation Systems Limited in Dublin, Ireland (100% voting rights ownership) and Santoku Senpaku Co., Ltd. In aviation, it works on operating leases of aircraft it owns, sales of aircraft to investors, and asset management services for aircraft held by domestic and overseas investors, among others. Avolon Holdings Limited, an Irish aircraft leasing company in which it acquired a 30% stake in November 2018, is an equity-method affiliate, and the company states that through their mutual complementarity it aims to raise its presence in the global aircraft leasing market. In ship-related operations, it is pursuing asset rotation, investment arrangements for domestic corporate investors, ship asset management, expansion of fee income from ship brokerage, and expansion of business areas through capital and business alliances. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥130,016 million, up 9% from the previous year, and operating lease revenue was ¥102,827 million (up 6%). The number of employees is 325 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.976c2a1a2c2867a5: This is a business in which ORIX Real Estate Corporation, ORIX Real Estate Investment Advisory Co., Ltd., ORIX Asset Management Corporation, Daikyo Inc. and others conduct real estate development, leasing and management, operation of facilities such as hotels and inns, and real estate asset management. Taking into account changes in the external environment, such as rising construction costs, it is pursuing real estate investment after carefully assessing profitability and risk, and is advancing asset management that is less affected by real estate market conditions, housing-related businesses centered on condominium sales, and facility operations. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥530,901 million, up 7% from the previous year. By breakdown, service income was ¥346,522 million (up 7%), sales of merchandise and real estate were ¥126,074 million (up 17%), and operating lease income was ¥52,300 million, down 15%. Number of employees was 9,186 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.c72f7bca46164a83: This is a business in which ORIX CORPORATION, ORIX Auto Corporation, ORIX Rentec Corporation, Yodogawa Transformer Co., Ltd. and others conduct financial and various fee-based businesses, as well as leasing and rental of automobiles, electronic measuring instruments, ICT-related equipment and others. In corporate sales, in addition to finance that emphasizes profitability, it is engaged in fee-based businesses that widely offer products and services such as life insurance and real estate brokerage to small and medium-sized enterprises in Japan, and it is also focusing on succession support and M&A brokerage. Regarding its automotive business in maintenance leasing, the company states that it has one of the industry's top-class fleet management volumes and provides automobile-related services on a one-stop basis. In rental through ORIX Rentec, in addition to electronic measuring instruments, ICT-related equipment and transformers, it is expanding into new services such as robots and 3D printers. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥487,842 million, up 6% from the previous year, and operating lease income was ¥301,626 million (up 7%). Number of employees was 4,961 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.f57eb2a4c50d1240: A business that conducts finance and investment in Asia and Australia. Subsidiaries including ORIX Asia Limited (Hong Kong), ORIX Leasing Malaysia Berhad, PT. ORIX Indonesia Finance, ORIX Australia Corporation Limited, ORIX (China) Investment Co., Ltd., ORIX Capital Korea Corporation, Thai ORIX Leasing Co., Ltd., ORIX Auto Leasing Taiwan Corporation, ORIX Corporation India Limited and ORIX Leasing Singapore Limited handle this business, undertaking leasing, lending, automobile leasing and car rental by country. ORIX Leasing Singapore Limited became a wholly owned subsidiary in January 2025 through the acquisition of additional shares. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥243,414 million, up 3% from the previous year. Number of employees was 4,977 as of March 31, 2026.
entries.f835bd3efd3385ed: This business engages in renewable energy, electricity retail, energy conservation services, solar panel sales, waste treatment and resource recycling, both in Japan and overseas. It is carried out by companies such as ORIX Environment Corporation and Elawan Energy S.L., which develops and operates wind and solar power plants in Spain (acquired in July 2021 and made a wholly owned subsidiary in February 2023). The company states that, as a comprehensive energy provider, it aims to expand service revenue by advancing its renewable energy and electricity retail businesses, and that in solar power it owns and operates power plants with some of the largest total output capacities in Japan. In waste treatment, the policy is to make new investments in facilities. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥209,231 million, up 12% from the previous year. By breakdown, service revenue was ¥173,340 million, down 3%. The number of employees is 975 (as of March 31, 2026).
